description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Permission class, a Catalyst controller handling project permission management, including listing, adding, editing, making owners, and revoking permissions within a web application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Permission
classes.description: Controller class for managing project permissions, including listing, adding, editing, transferring ownership, and revoking permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list project permissions, including organization and user permissions, with options to edit, revoke, and add permissions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add new organization or user permissions to the project.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load permission data for a specific user or organization based on the provided ID.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the role of an existing permission.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Handles POST requests to transfer project ownership to a user.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Handles POST requests to revoke (delete) a permission.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect back to the permissions index page.
